name: NavigationMenu
purpose: Provide disclosure navigation with coordinated triggers, links, content, viewport geometry, focus, keyboard, pointer, and dismissal behavior.
useWhen: Site or product navigation contains top-level links and disclosure panels of related destinations.

avoidWhen.condition: The interface is an action menu, persistent route list, or tab panel switcher.

composition: Compose Root > List > Item containing Link or Trigger plus Content; use one Viewport for shared positioned content and Indicator when the styled layer needs trigger geometry.

rules.statement: Use NavigationMenu for destinations, not commands, selections, or arbitrary popover content.
Use the primitive's trigger, content, viewport, arrow, offset, focus, and dismissal contracts instead of manually positioning a competing overlay.

commonMistakes.mistake: Positioning content against the page or logo rather than its owning trigger/viewport, or using menuitem semantics.
commonMistakes.correction: Keep the documented List/Item/Trigger/Content/Viewport composition and native link semantics.

validation: Test pointer hover, click, keyboard opening, arrow navigation, focus transfer, outside dismissal, Escape, and RTL geometry.
Confirm links navigate normally and action-menu roles are absent.
